Becca (PM): Heads-up: StratosFold case draft is in drive. Need legal ok on one quoted stat, PR embargo timing, and Sales lead routing. Link in thread.

embargo-bot: Embargo set for 2024-05-20T17:00:00Z. Reminders: 24h and 1h before.
Lia (Sales): For routing: AE-NorthAmerica, AE-EMEA, and Strategic-Partners. Add UTMs and a lead tag `case-study-interest`. Need example webhook JSON for engineering.
Ravi (Content): Sample UTMs: `?utm_campaign=stratosfold_launch&utm_source=social&utm_medium=cta&utm_content=case_cta`. Webhook example: `{ "email": "lead@org.com", "utm_campaign": "stratosfold_launch", "region": "na", "tags": ["case-study-interest"] }`.
Hannah (Legal): Legal redlines uploaded: legal_redlines_stratosfold_177250.pdf. I requested signed release for the numeric stat and explicit product-name consent. If no signed consent by EOD Tuesday, use conservative phrasing.
Becca (PM): I just emailed StratosFold legal and scheduled a 10-min signoff tomorrow 8:30 PT. Plan B: publish without the number but run the webinar CTA.
Diego (Demand): Once legal clears, I'll build the landing page and wire the registration funnel. Lia, ping me for AE mapping and Slack alert format.
Lia (Sales): Will prep the AE rotation and Slack alert payload. Also want the landing URL before the press send.

Becca (PM): Thanks all. Follow-ups: Hannah final signoff, StratosFold reply, Diego landing page, Lia AE routing. Back here after signoff call. :white_check_mark:
